subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding gross versus net income and where common paycheck deductions go
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student subtracts a set of sample deductions from a gross pay amount using physical calculation tiles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a paycheck deduction (taxes, retirement contribution) to what it's used for
exercise.abstract: Student calculates net pay from a given gross pay and set of deductions

misconception_flags: confuses gross pay (before deductions) with net pay (after deductions)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
